instruction: Change the email account "anonym-x2024@outlook.com" server from Outlook to use Gmail's IMAP server (imap.gmail.com).

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the server configuration for an existing account. Evaluator uses existing check_csv metric to verify the account now uses Gmail IMAP server and no longer uses Outlook server. No custom functions needed - reuses existing check_csv from general.py.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: postconfig uses firefox_decrypt.py to extract Thunderbird account settings to CSV, then get_cache_file reads the cached CSV correctly
Metric logic is correct: check_csv verifies both that expected records exist (Gmail IMAP server) AND unexpected records don't exist (Outlook server) using proper CSV matching

Expected values are semantically correct: expect rule verifies new Gmail server (imap://imap.gmail.com) for the specific account, unexpect rule verifies old Outlook server (imap://outlook.office365.com) is removed
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both positive (new Gmail server exists) and negative (old Outlook server doesn't exist) aspects of the instruction
Type='rule' parameter handling is correct: check_csv accesses rules directly with rules.get('expect', []) and rules.get('unexpect', []) without incorrect patterns
Practical and feasible: uses well-known firefox_decrypt tool with correct CSV output format (-f csv -d ,) and correct Thunderbird profile path
